content.label: Any student from MBM University passionate about computing, software engine
content.value:
Any student from MBM University passionate about computing, software engineering, coding,
                            or design is welcome! We welcome all years and all engineering disciplines.

content.label: EPIC gives you hands-on coding experience, exposure to real-world projects,
content.value:
EPIC gives you hands-on coding experience, exposure to real-world projects, mentorship from
                            seniors, and a community of like-minded engineers, whether you're just starting out or
                            already competing at national hackathons.

content.label: Our members build full-stack web platforms, machine learning models, mobile
content.value:
Our members build full-stack web platforms, machine learning models, mobile apps, IoT
                            systems, and algorithmic bots for national competitions and community impact.

content.label: No, EPIC is completely free to join. We believe in accessible education and
content.value:
No, EPIC is completely free to join. We believe in accessible education and collaboration.
                            All workshops, events, and mentorship sessions are open to all members at no cost.

content.value:
We cover a wide range: Web Development (React, Node.js, Python), AI/ML (TensorFlow, PyTorch),
                            Cloud Computing (GCP, AWS), System Design, Competitive Programming, and more. Each wing has
                            its own focus areas.
